nom: bareMinerals SKINLONGEVITY Revitalizing Eye Cream with Niacinamide

avis.texte: I love this production. It is very smooth and thick, moisturizing.
Saw immediate improvement in smoothness, which continues to improve as the weeks go on. Hydrating. Works well under make up. Bought more to give as gifts because I love it so much.
I really like this eye cream. Instantly made my eyes appear bright and refreshed. Went on smooth and left no residue. I was given this product in exchange for a review.

avis.titre: Not sure I would buy it
avis.texte: It's a little thinner in consistency than I like; although I did feel like it brightened my skin up!

avis.titre: Good but not the best for me
avis.texte: I think is a great product, I have sensitive eyes and I never had any issues with it. I personally like thick consistency in eye creams and this one is more liquid. It works very well if you need hydration in that area and also works really well under makeup. I used for a month and I didn't see any improvement in my dark circles.
I've been using this after some really hard times, lots of crying. And it made my makeup less racoon eyes look normal. Can't say enough good!
I used this product in the morning and night I didn't see a change in my dark circle

I used this product for 30 days in the morning and night. It goes on smooth and there isn't really a smell but I honestly did not notice any difference as far as my skin. For the money, I would go with something else.
I've been using this for a few weeks now. It goes on super smooth without any sticky residue. A little bit goes a long way! No odor either.

This is a light, refreshing eye cream that immediately absorbed into my skin. It has a nice gel-like consistancy with no strong fragrances or colors. My eyes feel moisturized, refreshed, and less wrinkled after daily use. Overall a great product.
Has a nice not over powering scent and feels good on the skin

The texture is bouncy and airy so it feels nice on the skin. It wears decent under makeup but it didn't WOW me. I can't say i would purchase on my own. I enjoyed the natural ingredient list but I just didn't see any significant results.

avis.titre: 5 star because no complaints as of now..
avis.texte: Cream was lightweight. Cooling and smelled great. Usually some eye creams bother me or give me a milia pimple, this one didn't!

BUY IT! This eye cream has made the world of a difference in the appearance of my under eyes! This is seriously one of the best eye creams I have ever used! It actually brightened my under eye! Do not hesitate, buy it!

Thus far this eye cream has been great! The cream is very light and silky with a very smooth application requiring very little product usage for full coverage of the eye area, allowing the longevity of use more affordable than most products out there. I have hooded lids and am hypersensitive to how things "feel" on my skin and have struggled to find a product that doesn't leave a filmy, sticky, or for a lack of better words, greasy feeling until now. I haven't used this long enough to give a fair assessment on overall long term results but I've never been disappointed in bareMineral products and I can't imagine this would be any different.

This claims to help with eye dark circles and under eye bags. Ive been using it 2x a day for about two and a half weeks. I noticed a slight difference in my under eye bags. I didn't really see much difference in my dark circles. It comes in a small jar and it wasn't easy to get the product out. It's not a heavy cream which is good in this heat. I'm going to keep using to use it up but I wouldn't rebuy.

I felt like this was a very nice eye cream for sensitive skin. The texture is not oily or thick at all. It is more like bouncy and water-based. I like that there was no heavy sent to it. I think it did help moisturize my under eye area quite nicely. Makeup went on nicely the next day after using it. i've been using it for several weeks and I don't think I've noticed any major differences in skin firmness or wrinkles. I am a side sleeper, so I'm not sure if that has anything to do with it. Occasionally, I would put this on my forehead. If I had leftover moisturizer on my fingertips and my forehead did have small tiny breakouts. But my under eye area did not. I did not have overly watery eyes with this either. So I think that, even though I do have some sensitive skin, my skin tolerated it pretty well.

avis.titre: I love the quality, wish it came in different packaging
avis.texte: I try to use my face creams/ eye creams etc in squeeze tube type packaging. I feel like it is unsanitary to dip my fingers into the container. If this brand of cream was in a container similar to the Elemis I would buy it again. I felt the consistency was nice and refreshing.

This is a gel cream product but its like a watered down gel which makes it hard to get our of the jar. I like that it has mineral herb complex with no synthetic fragrances. My eye area does seem smooth and a little hydrated after application. My makeup also goes well on top. I wish it was a little more hydrated.... I dont think the formula is anything special that I need it in my skincare routine.

I've been using the product for a while, yet I don't see any changes. Maybe the product needs to be used for a longer period of time. Over all though, the cream felt smooth and the scent was very light and not overbearing like other eye creams I have tried.

I got this for free to try and love it so far! It's lightweight and hydrating without being greasy or runny. It's perfect for summer time! The packaging is adorable as well. I can't speak to long term effects as I've only been using for a week but I do love what it's done for my under eye so far!!

avis.titre: A nice cream in a nice package
avis.texte: I received Bare Minerals SKINLONGEVITY Revitalizing Eye Cream with Niacinemide from BzzAgent in exchange for an honest review. Now, everyone proclaims that thy have sensitive skin. Well, I'm the real deal! A lot of products make me feel like I set a flame to my face. I've been hesitant to try anything with nicinamide, but I figured, what the heck, let's give it a whirl! I can't speak to its anti-aging effects, because that takes longer than the time frame allowed to submit a review. I can, however speak to the experience. The cream is thicker, but not so much that it leaves a waxy layer or great effort at rubbing it in (Think Tatcha). It did NOT burn! I was able to leave it on! I was surprised. I've been using it for a little while and it provides moisture, is inoffensive with its fragrance, and has a cute spa-esque packaging. I am open to purchasing this in the future. I feel safe recommending it to the gals out there with TRULY sensitive skin.

Bare Minerals makes really great products and their Revitalizing eye cream is no exception. This is a very light cream and a little goes a very long way. The product is scent free and non irritating to the eyes. I am 52 years old and experiencing several issues around my eyes. First, it helped moisturize the area which decreased fine lines. My skin was definitely improved and visibly brighter. Any puffiness to the area was drastically decreased. The more stubborn dark circles showed marked improvement. I still wish there was something that would totally erase those circles. The following picture is without make up except for mascara. Overall, I am definitely impressed. I will purchase this product in the future.
This undereye cream is very moisturizing and leaves my eyes looking hydrated. It's thick and a little goes a long way. I would definitely purchase again!

I have been enjoying this niacinamide eye cream! It has a wonderfully light feel—nothing heavy or greasy—which makes it perfect for both morning and night use. Despite being lightweight, it's surprisingly moisturizing and keeps my under-eye area soft and hydrated all day. I've noticed a smoother texture and less dryness since I started using it. A new staple in my skincare routine!

I tried the skinlongevity eye cream without any real expectations. However, I was blown away by the results in that my eyes are less puffy and the skin around them has greatly improved! I'll definitely keep purchasing and am looking forward to trying more skinlongevity products!

I really like this eye cream! It feels light and smooth under my eyes. After a few days, my skin looked less tired and more fresh. The cream has niacinamide, which helped reduce dark circles and made my skin brighter. It's not greasy at all and works great under makeup. I use it every morning and night — a little goes a long way. Totally recommend it if you want healthy and glowing skin around your eyes!

I love how light this cream is and you still only need a tiny bit to cover both eye areas. I definitely noticed brightness and smooth hydration around my eyes. I have very dark circles and I didn't notice a huge difference, but it's only been a couple weeks so I will give that more time.
Super nourishing and hydrating but not too thick and didn't make me break out in millia. Very nice produc my and nice smell

As a long-time fan of Bare Minerals, I was excited to try the SKINLONGEVITY® Revitalizing Eye Cream with Niacinamide. My initial impressions were quite positive: the rich gel consistency feels wonderfully cooling upon application, and it has a subtle, pleasant scent. Overall, it's a lovely product to use daily for a refreshing feel, and I appreciate the quality I've come to expect from Bare Minerals. For individuals with more pronounced fine lines, dullness, or dark circles, it might require a longer period of consistent use to fully experience the benefits highlighted in the study, than the time I have been using the products which is about 3 weeks. But I look forward to continuing and see where it takes me!

Thank you for allowing me to try the product in exchange for a review. I've always been a fan of BM and this eye cream did not disappoint. It is soothing and cooling and I look refreshed every morning.
Can I say I love this eye cream enough? No. Creamy, gel like consistency that lays beautifully under makeup, nary a single pil in sight.

I received this eye cream in exchange for my honest opinion. This eye is light and absorbs quickly. Great for daytime use as it doesn't cause my eye makeup to smudge. I've noticed some improvement with the fine lines around my eyes. I would prefer a more hydrating and thicker cream for evening use. But overall a great eye cream to have in your daily routine.

I like that it's not greasy and has no fragrance. I know they say you have to wait like a month or two to see results but my skin seems to really like it so far! I am a contact wearer and I haven't had any irritation while using it.

I have tried sooo many eye creams that claim to brighten the under eye area, smooth fine lines and moisturize youth back into the skin. Most have lived up to their claims. Bare Minerals SKINLONGEVITY Revitalizing Eye Cream with Niacinamide has actually lived up to their claims hype! I have dark under eye circles that are hereditary (thanks mom.) I understand that eye creams can only do so much with dark circles, that's why I was pleasantly surprised that their minerals actually helped. The cream also smoothed out the fine lines I have under my eyes so my make up glides on smoothly and doesn't settle into those creases. I love this stuff so much!!

This product is great! The ingredients are clean and the product itself does not have any scent. It goes on silky and is really moisturizing. I have noticed a difference after 2 weeks of use. My under eye area is super soft and fine lines around my eyes appear lessened . I put this on and then apply my powder foundation. It doesn't change the appearance of my makeup and my eyeliner doesn't smudge. The bottle is small but lasts forever because the tiniest amount goes very far!

avis.titre: The best eye cream I have used
avis.texte: This is such a smooth eye cream and soaks in nicely. I wake to my eyes being less sunk in and puffy after nights of battling insomnia. Over time it has made my eyes look less tired. This is a great eye cream, not a miracle worker but you will definitely notice positive results.
It's just okay, didn't see any monumental change from using this unfortunately.

avis.titre: I will be buying more of this eye cream!!
avis.texte: I've been using this eye cream morning and night and wanted to wait to give my honest review after I had time to use it. It's creamy but absorbs nicely into my skin. Feels nice and cool going on. Wears well under makeup which is a huge plus for me. I've used other eye creams that cake and smear under my concealer but not this one! Looks like I found a new eye cream!!

After trying it for one month i can definitely say i see such an improvement in my eyes. The cream is so rich and creamy, it has little to no smell and lathers on so good. After applying it i immediately feel my eyes relieved.

I typically day and night use an eye cream that contains retinol. I have been using retinol around my eyes for a few years now. In the short amount of time I was given to do this , I have seen a slight difference around my eyes. Two weeks is not really a good amount of time to see a substantial review and skin. It typically takes 30 to 60 days to notice a substantial difference, but in the past two weeks, I have noticed that around my eyes, it does seem to be slightly plumper and the lines do not seem quite as noticeable. Since I've only used this for two weeks at this point I would recommend this to a friend, but I will continue to use this to see how much of a difference it truly makes since it takes 30 to 60 days to see a full noticeable difference.
This is a great creamy and hydrating undereye cream. Does seem to brighten any dark areas around the eyes.

Eye Repair Cream has been a great addition to my routine. It's lightweight, non-greasy, and super gentle on my sensitive skin. After a couple of weeks, my under eyes feel more hydrated, less puffy, and smoother overall.

Bareminerals came out with an amazing skincare line. The eye cream is nice. Its not lightweight but because the eye skin is sensitive it needs more protection. Overall i did see a brightening effect. Definitely give it a trt
I enjoy this eye cream. It's cool, smooth, and moisturizes the under eye nicely.

I received the skinlongevity revitalizing eye cream by bare Minerals in exchange for my honest review and I am so thrilled to be a part of this campaign. This eye cream is phenomenal!! It erases dark under eye circles and brightens the eye area. I put it to the test after some nights of insomnia, this eye cream made it seem as though I slept a full 8hrs. It not only depuffs tired swollen eyes but it left a nice texture and melted into the skin leaving a perfect surface to easily apply makeup over which helped with diminishing lines and wrinkles. Some eye creams I've tried don't work well under makeup and cause concealer to settle into fine lines and wrinkles and actually worsen their appearance. Lines and wrinkles were no trouble for this cream and not only that, it held up all day!! No weird settling, no caking or cracking appearance, just a smooth flawless canvas for the entire day! While I tried my best to use it morning and night, some days I only used it in the am, but I still noticed after a while a generally healthier and more youthful texture to my eye area. I truly can't praise this Bare Minerals eye cream enough!!

avis.titre: Cream that hydrates skin and reduces dark circles
avis.texte: I'm so happy I got to try the new Revitalizing Cream from bareMinerals! It's lightweight, absorbs quickly, and instantly hydrates my skin without feeling heavy. I noticed immediate brightness, hydration, and a healthy glow after just one use. It works beautifully under makeup—foundation applies smoothly and evenly after using this cream. After several weeks of use, I've seen a real difference: fine lines and wrinkles appear softened, and my dark circles are noticeably reduced (which no other cream has been able to do!). Another bonus—it has a gentle, pleasant scent that feels soothing. I'm truly impressed and will definitely be trying the full Skinlongevity collection.

avis.titre: Great texture and feel on the skin
avis.texte: This feels so refreshing on the skin, very lightweight and the texture is perfect. It isn't too thick or too thin and it makes everything feel fresh and moisturized

I've not used bareMinerals before, so this was my first experience with this brand. I was provided the product to try without cost to me. My first impression of the product was that the cream felt soft and light on my fingers as I was beginning to apply it to my skin. I appreciate that it had little to no fragrance, as that is very irritating to my eyes. Let me clarify "little to no fragrance": I mean that there was no added fragrance to the product, and its smell was the natural product and minimal and nothing unpleasant. I applied this around my eyes and under my eyes. It felt like it absorbed well into my skin. I didn't feel like I had product sitting on top of my skin or felt heavy; I appreciated the light feeling when I first applied the product. As I continued to use the SKINLONGEVITY® Revitalizing Eye Cream with Niacinamide for a couple of weeks, I noticed a reduction in my fine lines around my eyes; my dark circles were slightly faded. I have some puffiness in my lids, making me have a more hooded eye look. This eye cream seemed to diminish my lid puffiness by a noticeable amount, and this helped my eyes look more like they did when I was younger. Compared to other eye cream brands I've used, I liked this product. It felt very natural, and I felt confident in its ingredients. One problem I did have with this product was that I noticed I had some filminess on my eyes in the morning. I feel this may be due to my application and use rather than to the product. If I am ge
I normally have a dry under eye area, so this product really helped to moisturize and help with the look of fine lines! I love it and it feels great on!

avis.titre: One of the best eye creams I have used in a while!
avis.texte: This is normally the last step to my skincare routine. My under eyes soak it all up. They look great under makeup as well! I see less creases when I use it.

I tried this product out for over a week. I put it on before I went to bed and also spent bones before I would go out for the day. The thing I liked about it was that it was not greasy and you are able to put it on for example in morning before you leave and not having to worry about washing off your face before you go out like some other creams. I would say it brightened up my face a little bit. The negatives I did not see any improvement in my fine lines under my eyes if you are looking for that you may want another cream.

𝐒𝐊𝐈𝐍𝐋𝐎𝐍𝐆𝐄𝐕𝐈𝐓𝐘® 𝐑𝐞𝐯𝐢𝐭𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐳𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐄𝐲𝐞 𝐂𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐦 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐍𝐢𝐚𝐜𝐢𝐧𝐚𝐦𝐢𝐝𝐞 I love this eye cream. This is actually the first skincare that I got from bareminerals. It doesn't have a perfume scent but it has a natural herb scent, I can only smell it in the jar but no scent when I put it into my eye. The eye cream itself is a gel cream consistency, not easy to grab when I try to using my finger, I hope it can comes with a spatula in the future, it will also increase the sanitary issue. The cream is silky and absorb like a dream. It doesn't sting my eye and feels cushiony. My skin is plumped with hydrating after applying it.

Thanks to bareMinerals for letting me try this product in exchange for my honest review. This bareMinerals Skinlongevity Revitalizing Eye Cream is definitely a product that I recommend and would purchase again. The cream going on smoothly and feels cooling and refreshing upon application. The cream is not greasy at all and absorbs quickly which makes it more desirable for use in the morning before makeup application. I noticed virtually no scent to the product which is an important feature for me as I am very sensitive to strong scents. My eye area looked brighter and somewhat renewed after using the cream for multiple days. As far as the consistency of the product in the jar, the cream is not super thick which does make it feel lighter than other eye creams that I have tried previously. It is just a simple, light, refreshing, and luxurious cream.

avis.titre: Tired eyes? Not anymore! This is a product I would buy again
avis.texte: Been using the Bare Minerals Skinlongevity Eye Cream and love how lightweight and hydrating it is. Super smooth under makeup! Just wish it was a bit more powerful on dark circles—and for the price, it's a tiny jar. Still, solid for daily use!

avis.titre: I definitely would repurchase this revitalizing eye cream
avis.texte: I used this great eye cream by Bare Minerals with Niamicide twice a day. In the morning and in the night after cleansing. I definitely saw a difference. My under eyes appeared brighter with plumping my fine lines. The product is clean, with minimal scent. It hydrates, moisturizes my eye giving it a dewy appearance. Please make in a bigger size!

I recently tried this eye cream and love the texture of it and how quickly it absorbs. This product is more on the thinner side, so if you are looking for a heavy eye cream this isn't it, but I personally prefer lighter weight eye creams so that they do not interfere with concealer. I cannot attest to any of their revitalizing claims as I haven't been using this product for long enough, but it's moisturizing capabilities alone are perfect for me.

avis.titre: No noticeable result in fine lines but nice moisturizer.
avis.texte: I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. Before reviewing, I tried the BM Revitalizing Eye Cream for 20 days. My main areas of concern were wrinkles and fine lines. It is a nice moisturizer, feels great on my skin. It doesn't irritate my eyes during workouts or runs when I am outdoors and sweating. I was able to use it morning and night with no issues. It did not "pill" under my foundation. I do not wear under eye concealer so I cannot speak to that. I did not notice any change in fine lines in the 20 days but because it feels nice and lasts without feeling greasy, I will continue to use in the AM and find something stronger for PM wear.

First time trying a bare minerals skincare product, and I am pleasantly impressed!! Niacinamide is incredible for smoothing and brightening, and this eye cream felt cool on the skin in addition to being effective.

I am a harsh critic and this eye cream is amazing! It it so smooth and lightweight! My eye area is super sensitive and I had no issues what so ever with this cream. So happy to finally find one that doesn't bother my skin, dry it out, or make it red. I used morning and night and it had been great!
I use this both morning and night daily. I've been using it about a week and a half now and can already see my crowsfeet starting to soften. To say I'm excited is an understatement. It's a miracle!

Thank you bare minerals for sending me this to try. I have super sensitive eyes and cannot use most eyeshadows let alone eye cream. I've spent money on sensitive cream only for my eyes to burn and water. This cream doesn't burn or make my eyes water. It's absorbs very fast and works great under makeup. Only bad thing I can think of is the packaging. The lid of the jar is heavy and always falls off when opening or trying to close. Just something to watch out for

Thanks to Bare Minerals for gifting me the jar of SKINLONGEVITY Revitalizing Eye Cream with Niacinamide, so that I could try it and review it. This product is lovely, feels so fresh and light on my delicate eye area. I am using it above and below my eyes, gently tapping it all around the orbital area. It feels light and soft and leaves my skin feeling great. I am sensitive to anything with a lot of fragrance, but this is so comfortable that I will look at trying the other products in the line. For reference, I prefer unscented skin care products that are proven to perform ; in other words I am picky, and this is terrific!

I am very impressed with the results I have seen after using the bare minerals skin longevity cream. It is a mineral herb complex revitalizing eye cream. It has helped to reduce the fine lines under my eyes and has given them a brighter and smoother appearance.

avis.titre: I plan to add this to my daily skin routine!
avis.texte: Fiest off I absolutely love the cute glass tub it comes in. It is a heavy thicker glass and is a green color. Very classy and sleek! The smell is amazing as well,nothing too over powering,just the right amount. I did notice the creamy texture but it is easy to absorb and does not leave a sticky residue after. I did notice after a few days my under eyes appear to be brighter and more hydrated! I plan to use this as part of my daily skin routine. I highly recommend!

I love the way this feels. It does leave my under eyes hydrated looking and feeling. I don't feel that any bags or dark circles disappear but I enjoy using it regardless. I love the gel like feel and a cooling effect when I apply. It does blend out smoothly and easily.

I'll start off by saying I have used a lot of different eye creams both high-end and drugstore. This has to be hands-down the best ice cream I have ever tried. The eye cream has a beautiful, smooth, gel like consistency. The thing I love most about this eye cream is when you apply it it has a cooling effect which feels amazing. I do suffer with really dark circles around my eyes and after only about a week, I've already seen a huge difference in brightness. The eye cream also helps my concealer not crease like it typically would before using it. There is no smell and I'd love how beautiful the color scheme is it just feels so elegant. I've never been a big fan of bare mineral skin care, but after trying this eye cream, I am definitely willing to revisit the whole line. You literally only need a dab. The cream really absorbs nicely. I would like to mention I do have sensitive skin, especially around my eyes, and I have accidentally got this in my eyes a couple times, I have had no irritation at all.

avis.titre: No irritating and hides fine lines!
avis.texte: I love the spare minerals eye cream. I am extremely sensitive around my eye area and I have to be very selective and any eye cream that I try. This ice cream was so soothing in very much non-irritating. My skin often burns when I put on eye cream, even if it's labeled for sensitive skin. However, this ice cream was as if I was dabbing on water. I did not feel it at all, and it quickly soaked into my eye area. I found it to be non-greasy and easily absorbed into my skin. I've been using it for almost 2 weeks now, and I can already tell improvement in the fine lines around my eyes. I love the fact that it is made with natural ingredients that are healthy to my skin. Overall, I highly recommend adding this bareMinerals eye cream to your beauty routine. It is a fantastic edition, especially for sensitive skin.

I've been using this for a few weeks now and it's been a really nice mild formula with no irritation. I like that it's unscented and it goes on really smooth. Haven't used it long enough to see long term effects but I have noticed good under eye hydration. I received this product in exchange for a review - the opinions in the review are my own!
I received this product for free. It was light and moisturizing. However, I need something that helps depuff and smooth out the lines. It did not do any of that.

I've been using BareMinerals Skinlongevity Revitalizing Eye Cream for a few weeks now, and I'm seriously impressed. The texture is silky and lightweight, yet deeply hydrating. It absorbs quickly and is non greasy. The mineral rich Long Life Herb complex feels good on my tired eyes. I've noticed reduced puffiness and smoother skin, and my dark circles have started to fade. What I really love is how gentle it is no irritation, no stinging. The packaging is sleek and hygienic, and a little goes a long way. There is no scent so safe for those sensitive to scents. The only reason I gave 4 stars is because it does pill a tiny bit. I don't mind at night when I'm going to bed but would also like to be able to wear under my makeup.

(I received this product for free in exchange for my honest feedback.) I've only been using this eye cream for about a week, so I can't really say how well it works. However, I will say that it is really hydrating, and it leaves my skin feeling soft. It absorbs really well, and it doesn't irritate my sensitive skin.
I like this product, it's light and doesn't feel thick or sticky. Nice hydration around the eyes without weight. Worth a try for your skin routine! I received this complimentary for an honest review.

As a woman in my early 40's I am always on hunt for the best eye cream. This eye cream was depuffing and smoothing for my eye area. It made the eye area feel moisturized and soft. This has been really nice to use in between Botox appts, as I think it has softened and minimized the crows feet lines for me. I received this product in exchange for my honest and unbiased review.

There's some positives however there are more negative. Here are the pros and cons in my opinion : PROS: I love the packaging I think its sleek and classy. Dries quickly when applied. Is not sticky or heavy. Hydrates area applied CONS: I saw zero results. Jar doesn't close tightly Yellowish and dried out slightly when opened Used daily with no change. Application area was dried out n sensitive after use of 6 days consecutive. Too small of amount in jar

I received this eye cream as a gift for a campaign, and it's quickly become a staple in my routine. The texture is lightweight and cooling, absorbing easily without any greasy residue. It hydrates and refreshes the delicate under-eye area, reducing puffiness and making fine lines less noticeable over time. I noticed a significant improvement in the puffiness around my eyes, The packaging is also sturdy and resistant to falling or breaking, so it's practical and durable. A great everyday treatment for hydration and a little extra care!

I have been using this eye cream for a few weeks, day and night. I have found that it helps leave the skin around the eye smooth and it has brightened the skin slightly while reducing my eyes fine lines. The dark circles are still there but I can see they are lighter than before. With longer use I see it working more wonders for me. Best part about this eye cream is that I have sensitive skin and this doesn't irritate me in the slightest. In the morning I do notice a slight depuff in my eyes when using it. Definitely helps me look more awake when I use it first thing after waking up. I recommend trying this for yourself.

I've been using this eye cream for a few weeks now, and overall, it delivers on several of its promises. The texture is a lightweight, cooling gel-cream that absorbs quickly without feeling sticky or greasy, making it perfect for morning and night use. Right after application, the eye area feels refreshed and hydrated—especially helpful for tired eyes in the morning. In terms of performance, I noticed a visible improvement in puffiness within a few days, likely due to the cooling effect and soothing ingredients. The skin around my eyes also feels smoother and looks slightly more awake and brightened, though results on dark circles were subtle and may vary depending on the cause. I appreciate that it claims to support the skin barrier—my under-eye area feels more resilient and less prone to dryness or irritation, which is a big plus, especially if you use concealer regularly. While it's too early to confirm long-term anti-aging effects, my eye area does look more refreshed and radiant overall.
I use this in the morning after I've scrubbed my face with a cleanser.

avis.titre: Buy this if your eyes are "tired"!
avis.texte: I have been using this product for a couple weeks, morning and night, and I LOVE the way it feels!!! It goes on so smoothly without a greasy feeling. It makes a difference in the puffiness of my eyes! It's not "magic", we can't get that lucky, but it DOES make a difference! I LOVE it!!! And a LITTLE goes a LONG way!!! So the price is very fair as well!
I've added this eye cream to my daily skin care routine and it has been amazing! it's super hydrating and leaves my skin glowing! it's very light and has no scent, which is great for sensitive skin!

I received the bareMinerals SKINLONGEVITY Revitalizing Eye Cream for free from BzzAgent. This eye cream has a lightweight, silky texture that absorbs quickly and feels super refreshing. After using it for a few days, I noticed my under-eye area looked more hydrated and a little brighter — perfect for those early mornings! I feel clean and gentle, even on my sensitive skin. No irritation, no heavy fragrance, just smooth and nourished skin. I love it and will buy in the future.

My favorite thing about this eye cream is the lightweight nature, perfect for daytime use in the summer! I also really like that it's made with niacinamide, an ingredient I find works well with my skin. There is a very light, clean scent and works well under other products/makeup.

I really liked the texture of this eye cream and it felt hydrating. A little product goes a long way so the container of it will last a long time. The only thing I struggled with was sometimes I experienced some pilling with under eye concealer but once you get the timing right it works well. I got this product free in exchange for a review.

avis.titre: Perfect for those fine lines around eyes!
avis.texte: This product has been incredible for me. It is very easy to spread on and only takes a very small amount. I have been using this product for three weeks now and have noticed a difference in my fine lines around my eyes and I can tell a difference in my dark circles too! Another great quality I have noticed with this is that I can put this on even with my contacts in and it never burns or irritates my eyes like so many other creams have. I highly recommend this product and will be continuing use of it myself.
I use this daily, and have noticed an improvement in skin elasticity under my eyes.

With two toddlers, I have been struggling with dark circles under my eyes. I started trying this Revitalizing Eye Cream and it has helped tremendously! Not only does it feel hydrating, but I have seen a noticeable difference. It's a super simple step to add to my skincare routine and I use it morning and night. It's easy to apply and I haven't noticed any irritation.

This is a great eye cream. I love the texture and how thick it is. Goes on really smooth and helps smooth away fine lines. As someone with sensitive skin, it can be hard to find products that don't irritate or make me break out. This one is perfect!

avis.titre: I love how this product feels
avis.texte: This stuff is amazing it leaves the under of my eye hydrated and looking younger. I absolutely, love it, and we'll buy it again and again.

I have been pretty diligent about using this AM & PM for around the last 4 weeks and have definitely noticed the fine lines around my eyes being minimized. The cream is thinner than I usually like but a little goes a long way. I probably have half of the sample left still. I am excited to see how this minimizes the look around my eyes over the next few weeks. I would definitely recommend this and want to try the other products in this line for my forehead lines too!

avis.titre: Great product for dry mature undereye
avis.texte: I have been using this product for a few weeks day and night. I usually apply after eye serums to lock in moisture. This eye cream has a thick consistency with a refreshing smell. A little goes a long way. Plan to purchase again.

avis.titre: Love the finish and the feel!
avis.texte: Goes on so smooth, doesn't leave an oily finish, makes my skin feel hydrated and silky smooth. I really like it.

I started using this eye cream a few weeks ago, and I already see a difference. The skin under my eyes feels softer and more hydrated. I used to have small dry patches, but now they are gone. The cream goes on smooth and doesn't feel heavy or greasy. My dark circles look lighter, and my eyes look more awake in the morning. I like that it has niacinamide.

I received this product for free in return for a review. I've used this product for around 2 weeks now. I really love the texture and consistency (kinda jelly/yogurty). It feels so nice and cooling to put it on the skin. I also have very sensitive skin around my eyes and it tolerates the cream well. I like also putting it on my neck. I don't really see a difference but I think that it is very hydrating.

I've been using this eye cream for a few weeks and love how much brighter and smoother my under-eyes look. It's lightweight but really hydrating, and a little goes a long way. My concealer applies better and fine lines look softer.
This eye cream is quite nice! I like how it feels once you apply it because it's not too thick or sticky. I also feel like you definitely get a lot of products in the container which I really like.
I like because it is non greasy and feels refreshing. However I didn't see too much of a difference when using it twice a day.

I've been trying the Revitalizing Eye Cream from bareMinerals for a few weeks now and I really like it. It feels so soothing on my skin. It has a slight cooling sensation when applied. The texture is more like a gel cream and it absorbs instantly. It causes no irritation to my sensitive eyes. Although I cannot comment on the long term results, I highly recommend trying it for yourself

avis.titre: A little thin for an eye cream but seems to work
avis.texte: I received this product for free to review and I initially thought it might not work too well because of how thin it is but I do think it has improved the appearance of the fine lines around my eyes in the couple weeks I've been using it. Because it's thinner than expected I think it will last quite a bit longer than other eye creams I've used in the past! I will continue to use it.

I really like this eye cream. It has a very minor scent that doesn't bother my sensitivities which is great. It does a great job of hydrating/refreshing under my eyes and doesn't feel too thick or greasy like some products can. I have only been using it for a few weeks and do see some improvement in fine lines and dark circles, but I feel I would need to use it longer to see more dramatic results. A little bit of it goes a long way so I think it will last for quite some time which really increases the value for your buck. One additional thing I really like is the packaging. It's lovely & has a nice weight to it which makes it feel a little more luxe in my opinion. Disclosure: I received this product for free in exchange for an honest review.

I love how lightweight and hydrating this eye cream is! It is not greasy and wears really well under makeup, making it perfect for morning application! Also, the ingredients are vegan, cruelty free, and without fragrance. I recieved this product for free in exchange for writing this review.

The product is nice. It's like a watery jelly consistency and has a very mild pleasant smell. It goes on shiny but when it's absorbed in, it leaves a matte finish. I see a difference in fine lines when using it, but not long term. It isn't cooling which would be nice for an eye cream. I didn't notice a difference in my dark circles or puffiness.

I hate eye creams that make my lids feel sticky and heavy. Not only is it lightweight, the skin around my eyes is firmer, brighter and more even. Pro tip: I've been using it on the backs of my hands and they're smoother and less wrinkly too! I'm 42 years old and worry about my hands giving away my age just as much as my face, really pleased with the results!

I am in my middle thirties now and noticing more how my under eyes are telling my age. I have darker circles and soft fine lines that can be hard to manage. I loved the texture and gentle scent of this eye cream. I did see a nice improvement to the tone and texture of my under eyes. That zone is one of upkeep and maintained to see results. So not necessarily overnight, but this does show a good improvement over time.sm

Buy it!!!! Even tho I received this product as a free sample for my honest review, I will for sure buy more when I eventually run out. I use this eye serum every night and morning after I wash my face. A smal amount goes ALONG way. Within a week of using this product my baggy dark circles under my eyes have brightened up and I look more awake. This is a MUST have.
No strong scent and no irritation at all. My eyes sometimes water with eye cream and this one did not bother my eyes at all. It left my under eye smoother and less puffy. I will buy this one again!!

I've been using for more than a week and already saw results Since having a baby I've definitely been needed extra help with under eyes darkness this product has been amazing for helping me feel like myself again
Wow! This is a great product we received as a trial! It absorbs well into the skin and doesn't leave a residue!
This eye cream feels cooling, hydrating, and smooth under the eyes.
Using my index finger, I patted a pea size amount of product gently around my eyes. Within a few uses, I noticed an incredible difference in the appearance around my eyes.

Puffiness didn't seem to go down at all after 2 weeks of use. My under eyes do seem brighter. It definitely gives great moisture. A little bit of this does go a long way, so you will get your monies worth.
This is a good eyecream. I like that it has niacinamide to help with dark circles. It's lightweight.

This is the first time I have used and under eye cream. I had no idea what to expect but the results were remarkable. I noticed the dark shadows under my eyes were gone My skin looked brighter and even some of the crow's feet was starting to fade. I have been using this daily for the past couple of weeks once I apply under my eyes I let dry for about 10 minutes before I put my moisturizer and makeup on. I can definitely see positive results.

I spent over 4 weeks using and adjusting this product to fit it effortlessly into my current routine, with some changes along the way, I see results within an hour sometimes, instant under eye wakeup! It's the first product I reach for in the AM. Best to use 1st thing on clean toned skin and give it time to absorb after lightly patting into skin under the eye and the sides and finally a little on the lids patting upward. If I have time I let this sit for an hour while I carry on with my morning, don't fret, 5 minutes will work too. Of course use the serums, moisturizers, and suncreams after the "SKINLONGEVITY®️Revitalizing Eye Cream with Niacinamide"that I am so lucky to have gotten for free in exchange for sharing my "glowing" review

avis.titre: Really hydrating, great for daily wear - gentle formula
avis.texte: I received this product in return for my honest review so I wanted to be sure to use it for a few weeks before writing this. I will say my eye area typically is very sensitive and this did not irritate it at all. The area felt super moisturized and I found I had slightly less fine lines than usual after prolonged use. Has a very mild scent too which I appreciate. Overall I will definitely continue use because it's extremely hydrating and seems to firm up the area.

When I received my SKINLONGEVITY® Revitalizing Eye Cream with Niacinamide I started using it instead of the eye cream I was using that included retinal. I'm 46, so I probably wouldn't stop using retinal, but this is a good alternative if you don't need retinal yet or if you're skin is sensitive, to alternate with your retinal.

I've tried so many eye creams and i can honestly say this is the one im least satisfied with. The texture of the eye cream feels like a jelly, and its almost impossible to get a small amount on my finger tip to apply to my eyes. Plus, when i apllied, it feels very thick and doesnt absord to my skin quickly.
So moisturizing and such a nice texture. I've used this for maybe two weeks and I definitely see a difference. Will buy for sure.

avis.titre: An eye cream that actually works!
avis.texte: As a hairdresser by day I have the pleasure of staring at my sometimes noticeable dark circles under my eyes, all. day. long. I added this cream into my routine and I'll have to say it's a great addition! The cream isn't heavy or greasy, absorbs right into the skin and works its magic on those dark circles under my eyes! I received this product gratis in exchange for an honest review and I can't wait to incorporate more of the Skinlongevity line into my skincare routine.

I tried to use the Revitalizing Eye Cream and no matter how little I used or tried to avoid getting to close to my eyes, it still ended up drifting up into my eyes and if I was wearing my contacts it would make them cloudy.

Pros: Super lightweight eye cream that wears very well under makeup. No cracking or peeling whatsoever. Packaging is very nice of the product. Cons: I wish it was a creamier and more moisturizing eye cream. I felt it a bit lacking. I also wish that it had more of a "brightening" effect after application. Overall I had a good experience with this product but I think it's a bit overpriced and would likely not purchase it myself. (I received this product as part of a promotion)
